item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Portrait Photo Into Story Frame

turns.text: Can you make this fit a 9:16 Instagram story? Keep all my hair and shoulders—use a blurred copy of the photo behind it if needed. No text.

item.tests: Tests creating a vertical story from a square portrait without clipping the person or distorting the photo.

answer_sheet.Framing: Keep all the hair and shoulders visible in the original photo.
answer_sheet.Filling extra space: A blurred copy of the same photo behind the intact portrait is fine.
answer_sheet.Text and retouching: No text or retouching; preserve my appearance.

must_haves: The delivered image has a 9:16 vertical frame.
The sharp foreground portrait shows the same woman, curly hair and sweater as the attachment.
No hair or shoulder area visible in the source is lost.
The portrait is not stretched or squeezed.
Any added background space uses a blurred version of the source photo, with no text.

turns.text: can you make a pic from this pic

dialog.agent: Sure! What would you like me to change—for example, make it a professional headshot, turn it into a cartoon, change the background, or give it a cinematic look?
dialog.user: make it fit an instagram story, keep all my hair and shoulders. no text

turns.agent:
I couldn’t create the Story version because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was generated.

The planned edit is **9:16**, extending the photo rather than cropping it so all your hair and shoulders stay visible, with **no text**.

style.prompt: Reformat this exact portrait for an Instagram Story in vertical 9:16. Outpaint the canvas rather than cropping the original. Preserve the woman's identity, face, expression, curly dark hair, gray knit sweater, pose, natural lighting and park setting unchanged. Keep ALL her hair including top and both sides fully visible with comfortable margin, and keep both shoulders fully visible; extend the background and sweater naturally as needed. Center the original portrait within the taller composition. Photorealistic seamless continuation of the existing park above and below, no change of style. No text, lettering, logos, borders or watermarks.
